_note: Thirty test cases with physician review expectations, supplied to the author by an outside AI review on 23 November 2026. 'input' and 'physician_review_expectations' are as supplied. 'checks' is how scripts/run_review_cases.py scores a run: whether the red emergency banner should show (null = either is acceptable), billing codes the plan should contain (one from each group, in the expected or the possible list), and codes that should not be in the expected list.

cases.group: A. Chest pain and cardiovascular complaints
cases.title: Typical chest pain
cases.input: I'm a 58-year-old man with high blood pressure and diabetes. I've had chest pressure for an hour that goes into my left arm, and I'm sweating. I have Aetna.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Emergency recognition. ECG, troponin-based ACS evaluation, monitoring, other indicated testing. Do not delay care for pricing.

cases.group: A. Chest pain and cardiovascular complaints
cases.title: Low-risk chest pain
cases.input: I'm a 25-year-old woman with sharp chest pain that gets worse when I move my upper body. It started yesterday after lifting weights. No shortness of breath, fainting, or medical problems.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Assessment for serious causes; ECG may be appropriate. Troponin and imaging depend on clinical assessment. Avoid automatic comprehensive testing.

cases.group: A. Chest pain and cardiovascular complaints
cases.title: Possible pulmonary embolism
cases.input: I'm a 35-year-old woman with sudden chest pain when I take a deep breath. My heart is racing and I had knee surgery two weeks ago.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Urgent PE assessment, ECG, risk assessment, and appropriate imaging pathway. Do not assume a D-dimer alone excludes PE.

cases.group: A. Chest pain and cardiovascular complaints
cases.title: Aortic dissection
cases.input: I'm a 67-year-old man with very sudden, severe chest pain going into my back. I have hypertension and nearly passed out.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Immediate emergency recognition, resuscitation, and consideration of CTA aorta when appropriate.

cases.group: A. Chest pain and cardiovascular complaints
cases.title: Palpitations
cases.input: I'm a 32-year-old man. My heart sometimes races for a few minutes after coffee. Right now I feel normal. No chest pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Focused assessment, ECG; electrolytes or additional tests based on clinical findings. Avoid default CT or extensive cardiac workup.

cases.title: Appendicitis
cases.input: I'm a 24-year-old man with abdominal pain that started near my belly button and moved to the lower right side. I feel nauseated and have a fever.
cases.physician_review_expectations: CBC, metabolic testing as indicated, urinalysis, consideration of CT or ultrasound and surgical consultation.

cases.title: Biliary disease
cases.input: I'm a 43-year-old woman with pain in my upper right abdomen after meals. I feel nauseated and the pain has lasted five hours.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Labs including liver tests as indicated, RUQ ultrasound; assess for cholecystitis or biliary obstruction.

cases.title: Gastroenteritis
cases.input: I'm a 28-year-old man with vomiting and diarrhea since yesterday. I can keep some water down, I'm still urinating, and I don't have severe pain or blood in my stool.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Clinical assessment, hydration; tests and IV fluids only when indicated. Potentially low resource utilization.

cases.title: GI bleeding
cases.input: I'm a 72-year-old man taking apixaban for atrial fibrillation. I've had black stools and feel dizzy when I stand.
cases.physician_review_expectations: High-risk evaluation, CBC, chemistries, type and screen as appropriate, resuscitation and possible admission or endoscopy.

cases.title: Possible ectopic pregnancy
cases.input: I'm a 29-year-old woman with lower abdominal pain and vaginal spotting. My period is two weeks late and I feel lightheaded.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Time-sensitive pregnancy testing, hemodynamic evaluation, ultrasound and indicated labs. Urgent safety messaging.

cases.title: Possible stroke
cases.input: I'm a 68-year-old man. My wife noticed my speech suddenly became slurred and my right arm became weak 20 minutes ago.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Immediate stroke activation, bedside glucose, urgent neuroimaging and reperfusion eligibility assessment. No pricing-related delay.

cases.title: Migraine
cases.input: I'm a 26-year-old woman with a gradual headache exactly like my previous migraines. I have light sensitivity and nausea, but no weakness, fever, or neck stiffness.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Focused neurologic assessment, symptom-directed medication; imaging may be unnecessary with reassuring history and examination.

cases.title: Thunderclap headache
cases.input: I'm a 49-year-old man with the worst headache of my life. It reached maximum intensity within seconds while exercising.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Emergency assessment for SAH and other vascular causes. Urgent CT head, with further evaluation dependent on timing and findings.

cases.title: Minor head injury
cases.input: I'm a 30-year-old man who bumped my head on a cabinet. No loss of consciousness, vomiting, blood thinners, or confusion. I feel normal except for a small bruise.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Apply validated head injury criteria as appropriate; CT not necessarily indicated.

cases.title: Anticoagulated head injury
cases.input: I'm a 78-year-old woman taking Eliquis. I fell and hit my head. I feel okay, but I have a headache.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Urgent assessment, CT head generally indicated; consider disposition based on findings and support.

cases.title: Mild URI
cases.input: I'm a 22-year-old man with three days of runny nose, cough, and sore throat. I'm breathing normally, eating and drinking, and have no medical problems.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Symptom-directed evaluation; avoid default chest imaging, blood tests, or IV therapy.

cases.title: Pneumonia
cases.input: I'm a 64-year-old woman with diabetes. I've had fever, productive cough, weakness, and shortness of breath for four days.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Vital signs, oxygen assessment, chest imaging, selective labs; risk-based disposition.

cases.title: Severe asthma
cases.input: I'm a 40-year-old man with asthma. I'm very short of breath, my inhaler isn't helping, and I can barely speak in full sentences.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Immediate emergency treatment, respiratory monitoring, bronchodilator therapy, systemic steroids and escalation as indicated.

cases.title: Possible sepsis
cases.input: I'm a 76-year-old woman with fever and confusion. My family says I'm acting very differently today, and I'm very weak.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Immediate assessment for infection, hypoperfusion and alternative causes; targeted labs, cultures, fluids, antibiotics and possible admission.

cases.title: Uncomplicated cystitis
cases.input: I'm a 31-year-old woman with burning when I urinate and urinary frequency for two days. No fever, flank pain, vomiting, or pregnancy.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Focused urine testing as appropriate, pregnancy assessment when relevant, oral treatment if uncomplicated; no routine CT or IV antibiotics.

cases.group: E. Musculoskeletal, skin and procedural complaints
cases.title: Ankle sprain
cases.input: I'm a 27-year-old man who twisted my ankle playing basketball. It's swollen but I can walk four steps. No numbness or deformity.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Examination and Ottawa ankle rules; radiography only when criteria indicate.

cases.group: E. Musculoskeletal, skin and procedural complaints
cases.title: Wrist fracture
cases.input: I'm a 62-year-old woman who fell onto my outstretched hand. My wrist is swollen and visibly deformed.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Radiographs, analgesia, neurovascular assessment, splinting and possible reduction.

cases.group: E. Musculoskeletal, skin and procedural complaints
cases.title: Simple laceration
cases.input: I'm a 34-year-old man. I cut my forearm with a kitchen knife. The cut is about two centimeters long and bleeding has stopped.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Wound evaluation, irrigation, closure when indicated, tetanus assessment. Avoid unnecessary imaging.

cases.group: E. Musculoskeletal, skin and procedural complaints
cases.title: Abscess
cases.input: I'm a 38-year-old woman with a painful, swollen lump on my thigh for four days. It feels soft in the middle and I've had no fever.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Examination, possible bedside ultrasound, incision and drainage when appropriate. Antibiotics based on risk factors.

cases.group: E. Musculoskeletal, skin and procedural complaints
cases.title: Back pain without red flags
cases.input: I'm a 45-year-old man with lower back pain after moving furniture. No fever, leg weakness, numbness, cancer history, or problems with urination.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Focused examination, symptomatic treatment; generally no routine MRI, CT, or broad laboratory panel.

cases.title: Pediatric fever
cases.input: My 18-month-old daughter has a fever of 102°F, runny nose, and cough. She's playing, drinking fluids, and having normal wet diapers.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Age-specific risk assessment; no automatic comprehensive septic workup in a well-appearing toddler.

cases.title: Pediatric emergency
cases.input: My 3-year-old son is having trouble breathing. His lips look blue and he's getting very sleepy.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Immediate emergency response. Do not prioritize a cost estimate.

cases.title: Severe hyperglycemia
cases.input: I'm a 23-year-old man with type 1 diabetes. My glucose meter says 490, I've been vomiting, and I'm breathing unusually fast.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Immediate DKA evaluation, metabolic labs, ketones, fluids, electrolytes and insulin management as indicated; likely substantial resource use.

cases.title: Psychiatric emergency
cases.input: I'm a 36-year-old woman with depression. I'm thinking about killing myself tonight and have a plan.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Immediate safety and psychiatric assessment, targeted medical evaluation; no indiscriminate laboratory or toxicology testing without indication.

cases.title: Dental pain
cases.input: I'm a 41-year-old man with pain in a back tooth for three days. No fever, facial swelling, trouble swallowing, or breathing difficulty.
cases.physician_review_expectations: Focused oral evaluation, pain management and dental follow-up; no routine CT, CBC or IV antibiotics.
